**Job Requisition ID #

**26WD101877

**Principal Embedded Engineer, AI Solutions

****Position Overview

**Autodesk Technical Advisory is seeking a highly technical and customer-focused Embedded Engineer, AI Solutions to join our new Embedded Engineering (forward-deployed engineering) team.

You will work directly alongside strategic Autodesk customers to discover high-value workflows, model the data those workflows depend on, and build the AI systems for their Design & Make workflows to enable customer’s measurable business outcomes.

You will move fluidly from understanding a customer's workflow and architecture to writing code. You will spend your weeks writing production code to build agents and orchestration, retrieval and graph services, connectors and APIs - inside customer environments, alongside customer engineers. What you ship is concrete: AI agents, MCP servers and tools, domain and semantic models, knowledge-graph extensions, retrieval and context-resolution pipelines, integrations into ERP, PLM, BIM, enterprise data platforms, and eval harnesses to move new capabilities into production.

Unlike traditional project delivery, Embedded Engineering works deeply inside customer environments, connecting Autodesk technology and data with the rest of the enterprise. Insights developed through customer work will be translated into reusable agents, connectors, reference architectures, engineering patterns, and direct product feedback that shapes Autodesk's platform roadmap.

The successful candidate combines strong software and AI engineering skills with curiosity, customer empathy, business judgment, and the ability to operate independently when the problem is not yet well defined. This role is engagement-driven with travel up to 75% during active engagements, including extended periods working onsite with customers.

**We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.

**Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed below.

**Responsibilities

****Discover Workflows and Own the Outcome

**

• Partner with customer executives, business leaders, and technical teams to translate transformation objectives, operational KPIs, sustainability commitments, and digital initiatives into measurable, AI-enabled workflow outcomes.

• Lead co-innovation with customers to find high-value workflows, decision bottlenecks, data requirements, and integration opportunities, turning ambiguous business challenges into clear technical directions.

• Analyze end-to-end workflows across Autodesk and non-Autodesk systems to pinpoint friction, process inefficiency, data gaps, and the places where AI and agents genuinely change the economics.

• Own technical execution end-to-end - rapid prototype through architecture, build, integration, testing, governance, production deployment guidance, and adoption - with accountability for customer impact.

• Sequence the work and decide what not to build. Make explicit trade-offs between scope, speed, and durability, and defend them to both customer and Autodesk stakeholder

**Make Data and Context AI-Ready

**

• Assess customer data readiness - fragmented sources, ownership, quality, lineage, metadata, governance, permissioning, and integration constraints - required to support trusted AI and agentic workflows.

• Structure and connect design intent, project, product, and asset data, along with requirements, supporting evidence, approvals, decisions, and dependencies, into trusted AI-ready data and context models that enable reasoning, retrieval, and agentic action.

• Design ontologies, semantic layers, and knowledge graphs that business users recognize and agents can act on, including entity resolution across source systems, schema mapping, and permission models that survive contact with enterprise reality.

**Build and Ship Production AI

**

• Design and build production-grade AI-enabled workflows, agents, applications, and integrations that connect Autodesk products and platform capabilities with customers' broader enterprise technology environments.

• Build the retrieval and context layer these systems depend on - hybrid search, graph-grounded retrieval, tool interfaces, and MCP servers that expose governed enterprise context to agents safely.

• Make quality measurable. Build evaluation harnesses, golden datasets, guardrails, tracing, and observability so that agent behavior is testable before launch and monitored after it, and so that quality regressions and drift are caught in production rather than reported by users.

• Apply strong engineering practices across architecture, code quality, security, permissions, reliability, observability, testing, performance, and maintainability, adapting quickly to complex and constrained customer environments.

• Define the operating model for what you build - runbooks, ownership, escalation, and cost - and hand it over cleanly to customer teams or Autodesk services so value persists after the engagement ends.

**Feed the Product and Build Reusable IP

**

• Act as a frontline product discovery mechanism, translating customer learning into prioritized product requirements, platform capability gaps, roadmap recommendations, and opportunities for feature or API acceleration.

• Convert customer-specific learning into reusable Autodesk value - reference architectures, agent and MCP patterns, connectors, ontology templates, graph models, reusable code, evals, and technical playbooks - that reduces the cost of every engagement that follows.

**Build an AI-Native Practice

**

• Design, build, and operationalize the agents, workflows, and automations that make the Embedded Engineering organization itself faster and more effective, measuring success by both customer impact and scalable internal leverage. Continuously look for manual work to replace with agentic systems and reusable internal tooling.

• Stay at the frontier. Maintain working knowledge of new model capabilities, agent implementation patterns, and AI product development stacks, and bring what's genuinely useful into practice.

• Serve as a trusted technical advisor across the boundary - partnering with customer engineers, architects, and business leaders, and with Autodesk Sales, Customer Success, Technical Advisory, Product, and Platform teams - to unblock delivery and help teams navigate ambiguity, trade-offs, risk, and changing requirements.

**Minimum Qualifications

**

• 6+ years building and operating production software, including 2+ in a customer-facing or embedded role (forward-deployed or founding engineer). CS/Engineering degree or equivalent hands-on experience.

• Full-stack range. Expert Python plus one of TypeScript, Java, or C# - comfortable across backend, data pipelines, integrations, and a lightweight React surface when a workflow needs one.

• Cloud fluency in Azure or AWS: containers, serverless, managed data stores, and identity and networking inside customer-governed environments (e.g., infrastructure as code with Terraform, Bicep, or CloudFormation), with strong API, distributed-systems, CI/CD, and observability fundamentals.

• Agentic systems in production. You've built and run single- and multi-agent systems - tool schemas, memory, human-in-the-loop checkpoints - on a modern orchestration framework (e.g., LangGraph, LangChain, Bedrock AgentCore, etc), MCP making practical cost and latency trade-offs (e.g., model selection, caching).

• Evaluation as engineering. You build golden datasets and eval harnesses from real customer data, and you measure groundedness, task success, and retrieval quality using standard tooling (e.g., RAGAS, LangSmith, Langfuse).

• Retrieval and data readiness. You've built retrieval systems end-to-end (chunking, embeddings, hybrid search, reranking) over a vector store and can assess and fix messy enterprise data - lineage, permissions, entity resolution, schema mapping.

• Knowledge architecture for AI. You model domain semantics into AI-ready context - ontologies, semantic layers, knowledge graphs - and ground agents in it via GraphRAG or equivalent, using at least one graph technology (e.g., Azure Cosmos DB Gremlin, Amazon Neptune, Neo4j, or equivalent) and its query language (e.g. Gremlin, Cypher, SPARQL).

• Ownership under ambiguity. You take greenfield customer problems from framing to production and measured outcomes and can explain a non-deterministic system with equal credibility to an engineer and an executive.

**Work arrangement

**

• You'll work with one customer at a time on focused engagements, for specified duration, on-site at customer locations that may be outside your home country, with travel of up to 75%, subject to any immigration or other requirements (averages likely to be lower across the whole year). You remain an Autodesk employee throughout, and the intention is that Autodesk's policies, benefits, and time off apply on every assignment. Some customers may have their own onboarding, safety, security or other requirements, which will be discussed with you at the time.

**Preferred Qualifications

**

• Domain fluency in AECO, with the ability to ramp quickly on design-to-construction-to-operations processes.

• Autodesk platform fluency: Autodesk Platform Services (APS), AEC Data Model API, Autodesk Construction Cloud and Common Data Environment (CDE) concepts, Forma, Fusion, Flow, and Autodesk data models.

• Enterprise systems of record integration: ERP, PDM, PLM, BIM, project controls, cost, scheduling, and asset management, plus enterprise data platforms (data lakes, warehouses, Lakehouse, analytics platforms).

• Constrained enterprise deployment: customer VPCs, private, on-prem, or air-gapped environments, data residency and sovereignty requirements, SSO/SCIM, and formal security review processes.

• AI-native builder practice: routine use of AI coding agents, harnesses, and automation to multiply individual and team throughput, including spec-driven development: writing clear specs and executable acceptance criteria for coding agents, keeping changes small and reviewable, and verifying AI-generated code through automated tests and review.

• Production trust and safety: prompt-injection defense, permission-aware retrieval, provenance and audit trails, versioning, staged rollout, monitoring, and incident response.

**Ideal Candidate

**

• Ships. Has put things into production and can name the metric that moved.

• Treats evaluation as part of the product. Assumes agents will fail and builds evaluation, observability, and guardrails before scaling.

• Is fluent in both worlds. Understands the customer’s business process and the failure modes of non-deterministic systems.

• Thinks in reusable patterns. Instinctively asks, “How does this become an asset for the next ten customers?”

• Moves fast without leaving a mess. Knows when speed matters, when engineering rigor matters, and how to make that trade-off deliberately.

We are looking for a Financial Controller to lead the operational and analytical work behind our monthly close, group consolidation, project controlling and control environment of a fast-growing energy trading and technology group – and to rebuild them AI-first, so our numbers are faster, more reliable and ready for scale.

Why this role matters

Hybrid Greentech is scaling fast as a VPP, BRP and electricity retailer across Denmark, and Northern Europe. Energy trading means large and volatile daily revenue, cost and cash transactions – so quality , accuracy and liquidity control are not back-office topics; they decide how fast we can grow. This role exists to give management, the board and investors numbers they can trust, on time, and to build controls and automation that scale with the business rather than with headcount. The same discipline is needed in our consultancy arm, where technical consultants deliver advisory and EPC management projects: clear project economics, timely invoicing and early warning when a project drifts.

The role

As Financial Controller, you report to our Finance Manager and work closely with the CFO and our accountant in a small, hands-on finance team. You lead the operational and analytical work within the financial steering, reporting and finance and business analytics; running the month-end close, the consolidation of our group entities in Denmark and abroad, balance sheet reconciliations, project controlling and the day-to-day operation of our internal controls. This is an individual contributor role with high ownership and direct visibility towards management.

You will work in close collaboration with our settlement team, project managers and business owners to ensure adequate financial steering and reporting, partner with our accountant on more complex accounting topics, and work across trading, portfolio management, commercial and engineering. We are a tech-first company with high AI adoption, and we expect you to work that way too: AI tools, scripting and automation are your default approach to removing manual work from close, reconciliation and reporting – combined with the judgement to know when a number needs a human review.

What you will do

• Lead and execute the monthly close and group consolidation, including account mapping, intercompany eliminations, reconciliations and variance analysis, and prepare the monthly financial and business review for the CFO, management and the board.

• Set up and run project controlling – project budgets, hours and utilisation, work in progress, milestone and fixed-fee revenue recognition and timely invoicing – giving project managers and business owners clear steering on margin, estimate-to-complete and cash.

• Automate and rebuild our reporting flow – from ERP trial balances to consolidated P&L, balance sheet and cash flow – using AI tools, scripting and data pipelines, replacing manual spreadsheet steps with controlled, repeatable and documented processes.

• Operate and strengthen our internal controls within the framework set by the Finance Manager, including segregation of duties, payment and bank authorisations and documented business procedures, and drive follow-up on auditor recommendations.

• In close collaboration with Settlement, ensure trading-related balances – settlement, imbalance costs, customer prepayments and deposits, and collateral posted to TSOs, DSOs and exchanges – are correctly recognized, invoiced and reconciled

• Support cash and liquidity forecasting and management with the Finance Manager and CFO, including rolling cash forecasts, collateral and trading risk capital tracking, and early warning on cash exposure.

• Prepare and analyse the annual budget and monthly forecast updates for the Finance Manager and CFO, maintaining our driver-based budget model and following up on budget-versus-actual deviations with business owners.

• Handle key accounting areas such as revenue recognition and accruals, capitalisation of development projects, grant periodisation and month-end cost accruals, collaborating with our accountant on more complex accounting topics.

• Support in the year-end close and audit for all group entities, including annual reports, tax specifications and intercompany agreements, in close collaboration with Finance Manager and our external auditors.

• Work closely with our Settlement team and business owners to ensure adequate financial steering and reporting – turning data into insight on gross profit by revenue stream, cost of execution and unit economics, and building dashboards that let the business self-serve.

What you bring

Experience and skills (Required)

• 5+ years of experience as a controller, in audit or in a group finance role, ideally in a multi-entity set-up.

• A relevant degree in accounting, finance or economics (e.g. cand.merc., HD-R or cand.merc.aud.).

• Proven hands-on experience running month-end close, consolidation and year-end audit under the Danish Financial Statements Act (Årsregnskabsloven)

• Hands-on experience with ERP systems, preferably e-conomic

• Solid understanding of balance sheet accounting, revenue recognition, capitalised development costs, accruals and intercompany transactions.

• Experience with project controlling – budgets, work in progress, utilisation and project margin follow-up – ideally in a consultancy, engineering, Trading or EPC business.

• A genuine AI-first way of working: you use AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT or Copilot daily and can show concrete examples of finance processes you have automated (e.g. with Python, SQL, Power Query, APIs or low-code tools).

• Strong Excel and financial modelling skills combined with a structured, control-minded approach and high attention to detail.

• The ability to work independently in a fast-paced scale-up, prioritise under pressure and explain financial matters clearly to non-finance colleagues.

• Language: English (required); Danish

Nice to have

• Experience from energy trading, utilities, commodities or financial services – e.g. settlement, collateral, imbalance or margin processes.

• Experience with e-conomic, time registration or PSA tools, ERP migration to a more scalable platform, and BI tools such as Power BI.

• Experience with public grant-funded projects, transfer pricing or building internal controls in a growth company.

• A background from a Big 4 or mid-tier audit firm.

What we offer

• Real responsibility: the chance to improve how close, controls and reporting are run in a scaling energy trading group – not just maintain them.

• An AI-first workplace where you get the tools and the mandate to automate, experiment and rethink how finance is done, working closely with our CFO, trading and tech teams with exposure to board and investor reporting.

• Competitive compensation and performance-based incentives.

• A collaborative environment with short decision lines, high trust, and strong cross-functional execution.

• The opportunity to work with forward-looking customers and partners driving electrification and the green transition in Northern Europe.

Ready to apply?

Ready to build an AI-first finance function for a company where every megawatt-hour traded must be settled, reconciled and controlled? If you combine accounting rigour with a builder's mindset, we would love to hear from you.

Deadline

Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis until 10 December. We reserve the right to close this vacancy earlier if a suitable candidate is identified and accepted.

About Hybrid Greentech

Hybrid Greentech helps Battery Energy Storage Systems and flexible assets perform across their full lifecycle, from project readiness to real-time multi-market trading. We are a vertically integrated VPP, BRP and retailer. We combine analytics, EPC management, asset integration and automated trading to turn flexibility into reliable value for the grid and for asset owners. We are a diverse, international team of 45+ based in Høje Taastrup, building technology that makes 100% renewable energy workable in practice.

We’re looking for a data platform lead with a commercial mindset, ready to help our clients find out where AI fits and to play a central role in growing their business around it.

**What You’ll Do

**In this role, you’ll advise clients on their data platform and AI choices, design the architectures, build them yourself, and lead the teams that deliver them. It’s a role that’s equal parts business-facing and technical: you’ll design and build on Snowflake, Databricks, and Microsoft Fabric, and be just as at home in the client meeting.

Beyond the client work, you’ll team up with colleagues across The Tech Collective and Implement to spot opportunities, shape scopes, and help win the work. Having built these platforms makes you credible when you sell them, and selling them keeps you building what clients need. As the team grows, you’ll also help shape the offering itself: reference architectures, propositions, and people.

**What You’ll Bring

**You’re a builder at heart. You have experience designing and delivering data platforms in at least one of Snowflake, Databricks, or Microsoft Fabric, and you can weigh them against each other. To be a great fit, it helps if you have:

• A commercial mindset – you spot opportunities, shape scopes, contribute to proposals, and are comfortable in a room with senior business stakeholders

• Fluency in AI and how it depends on the data platform – from data foundations and governance to taking AI use cases into production

• Experience leading projects or engineering teams (e.g., as an engineering manager or tech lead) while staying close to the code

• Clear communication with both engineers and executives, and the ability to turn platform choices into business decisions

• A collaborative style – you develop the people around you and enjoy building something together with others

**What We Offer

**At The Tech Collective, you’ll be part of a team that blends nerdiness, energy, and a sincere interest in people. You’ll have influence over how we grow, close sparring with experienced peers, and the chance to shape the offering as it develops.

Our culture is built on high autonomy with responsibility, co-creation, and active knowledge-sharing. You’ll work on projects across industries and disciplines – from strategy rooms to solution pilots with leading technologies. And to support your growth, we also provide internal training, keynotes, and hands-on learning across AI, data, cyber, and digital strategy.

**How To Apply

**

• We review applications on an ongoing basis, so please submit your application ASAP

• Please apply with your CV, cover letter, and university transcripts

**About The Tech Collective

**The Tech Collective is a fast-growing consulting company powered by Implement Consulting Group. We help organisations unlock the immense potential of data, AI, and analytics, ensuring that they are ready for what comes next.

Ready to shape the digital future with us?

_Do you want to influence the future of intelligent flow measurement? Are you motivated by solving complex technical challenges alongside highly skilled specialists? Are you ready to take ownership of hardware concepts and requirements that enable industry-leading measurement performance?

**Here Is What The Job Entails

**As our Senior Hardware Engineer, you will play a key role in shaping the future of flow measurement technology. Working closely with specialists in signal processing and measurement science, you will define and develop hardware solutions that enable industry-leading measurement performance.

More specifically, you will be:

• Defining requirements and architecture for next-generation flow meters

• Driving technical decisions from concept to production

• Collaborating with external ASIC design partners while working closely with specialists in signal processing and measurement technology

• Translating measurement principles into robust hardware solutions

• Supporting verification, validation, and product integration

We offer a unique opportunity to work on technology that forms the core of our products and creates value for utilities and consumers worldwide. You will join a small team of highly skilled specialists where your expertise will have a direct impact on technical decisions and future solutions. The role combines deep technical challenges, significant influence, and the opportunity to shape technologies that will remain at the heart of our products for years to come.

**Meet your future team

**You will report directly to the Director of Meters and become part of a highly specialized development environment. Your closest teammates will be an expert in signal processing and a physicist specializing in measurement technology, giving you a unique opportunity to work where hardware, algorithms, and physics converge. At the same time, you will be surrounded by a larger team with colleagues from various backgrounds who share a common passion for solving complex technical challenges. We believe the best solutions are created through close collaboration, open dialogue, and a willingness to challenge each other's thinking.

Did you know? Many of our patented innovations originated through close collaboration between physicists, hardware developers, and software engineers gathered around the same workbench.

**Less About Us, More About You

**We are looking for an experienced hardware engineer who enjoys solving complex technical challenges and turning ideas into robust solutions. You are naturally curious, seek to understand the underlying principles behind a problem, and thrive when collaborating with specialists across multiple disciplines to create the best possible solution.

In order to succeed, we imagine that you:

• Hold a degree in Electronics Engineering or a related technical discipline

• Have extensive experience with hardware development.

• Thrive when working closely with specialists from multiple technical domains

• Combine analytical thinking with a pragmatic approach to problem solving

• Communicate complex technical topics clearly and confidently with both internal and external stakeholders

Experience with measurement systems, sensor technologies, mixed-signal electronics, or semiconductor development is considered an advantage, but not a requirement.

Whilst you may not meet all the qualifications listed above, you could still be a good candidate for the position. For us, curiosity, your eagerness to learn and the confidence to take ownership beyond your own area of expertise matter just as much as experience. If you find the role intriguing, do not hesitate to apply.

As we are an international organization it is important that you are fluent in English.

**We are more than an ordinary workplace

**We cherish the good colleagueship which we all contribute to, the only limit is your engagement. As we are a big organization you are bound to find one or more colleagues who share the same interest as you. This might be in our board game club, on our cycling team, during our yearly summer festival, or on the padel court. For example, our Team lead, Service Delivery is also our volunteer padel instructor while one of our Software Test Engineers run weekly spinning classes.

Besides the best colleagues you could imagine, we also offer:

• Work life balance through flexible working hours

• Employee benefits including a healthy canteen, fitness facilities, in-house dental clinic, hairdresser, and a free health clinic

• An active employee association that fosters a collaborative and supportive workplace community

• Beneficial health care and insurance package

**Do you want to be a part of Kamstrup?

**Please submit your application by using the link below. Applications are reviewed on a continuous basis, and you can expect a response within six weeks.

The job will be located at Kamstrup's headquarters in Stilling, between Aarhus and Skanderborg.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Director, Meters, Søren Tønnes, on phone: +45 89 93 10 00.

**_Get to know us

_**_At Kamstrup, you'll become part of a close-knit community that genuinely cares about one another, fostering connections both in and out of the workplace. Our team comprises innovators, dreamers, and doers, united by an unyielding passion to challenge the status quo, find better solutions, and constantly push the boundaries of what's possible by being driving by our purpose: We Make What You Measure Matter. With an unwavering commitment to growth, we offer opportunities for you to leverage your skills and drive our business to new heights, empowering you to leave your mark on our future and grow with us.

_Explore more on our website, see our annual report, and stay updated through LinkedIn for the latest news and job openings.

**Job Description

**

Head of Marketing - Nordics and UK

Posting Start Date: 9/9/26

Gentofte, 83, DNK, 2820

**Head of Marketing – Nordics and UK

**

• Location: Gentofte, Copenhagen, Denmark

• Working hours: Full-time

• Work model: Hybrid

• Contract type / duration: Permanent

• Travel: Regular travel across our markets, particularly the Nordics and the UK

Are you passionate about turning brand and commercial strategy into activation that drives real impact with consumers? Do you want to be the critical link between Brand Marketing and Commercial teams across the Nordics and the UK? Then you might be the person we are looking for.

As our new Head of Marketing – Nordics and UK, you will be part of the Trade & Activation team and play an important role in translating brand and commercial strategies into impactful market activation plans that drive adult consumer engagement, strengthen brand equity and deliver commercial growth across the Nordic and UK markets. You will work closely with Brand Marketing and Commercial teams to ensure our brands come to life consistently and effectively across channels, customers and consumer touchpoints. Reporting to the Trade & Activation Director for Europe, you will lead and develop a team of 7 direct reports. This is a great opportunity to act as the critical link between brand strategy and commercial execution in an international organization.

**What Your Day Will Look Like

**In this role, you will typically focus on:

• Own the activation agenda for our Nordic and UK markets, translating brand and commercial priorities and channel-specific strategies into impactful market programs.

• Develop and execute annual activation plans that drive adult consumer recruitment, engagement, retention and brand preference across the portfolio.

• Partner closely with Sales and Key Account teams to build customer activation plans that strengthen distribution, visibility, conversion and category growth.

• Translate consumer, shopper and market insights into activation programs that create measurable commercial impact.

• Manage the development and deployment of activation toolkits, point-of-sale materials and execution standards to ensure consistent market execution.

• Monitor activation performance, evaluate ROI and continuously optimize investment allocation, contributing to annual commercial planning.

**What You'll Bring

**

• Significant experience in Brand Activation, Trade Marketing, Shopper Marketing, Consumer Engagement or Commercial Marketing, ideally within tobacco, nicotine, FMCG, beverages or other regulated consumer goods industries.

• A proven track record of developing and executing activation programs that deliver measurable commercial results, with a strong understanding of consumer behavior, shopper dynamics and route-to-market strategies.

• A commercially driven mindset, with experience managing activation budgets and optimizing resource allocation across multiple markets to connect investment to business performance and ROI.

• Proven ability to influence and collaborate across Sales, Marketing, Finance, Insights and external agency partners, operating effectively within matrix organizations.

• A proactive, growth-oriented attitude with a passion for excellence in execution and continuous improvement.

• Strong communication and presentation skills, with fluency in English and a Nordic language.

**Working At STG & What To Expect

**At Scandinavian Tobacco Group (STG), we are so much more than what meets the eye. We combine the strength of global brands with the entrepreneurial mindset that allows people to make a real impact. Here you'll have the opportunity to grow your career, collaborate across borders, and help shape what's next. At STG you'll find more than a role—you'll find opportunities to grow, collaborate across borders, and make a meaningful impact.

Incentives and Benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area and relevant market benchmarks.

Ready to be part of something bigger? Apply now and discover much more.

We assess each application against the key competencies and requirements for the role. If your experience and skills are a good match, you'll be invited to continue through our hiring process, which may include the following steps:

• Recruiter screen

• Interview with the hiring team

• Assessment, case study, or work sample, if relevant

• Final interview with leadership or key stakeholders

Scandinavian Tobacco Group is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

**About The Role

**We are looking for Senior DevOps engineer with deep expertise in CI/CD to join our Platform Engineering team in Copenhagen.

This role is focused on modernizing how software is built, tested, packaged, delivered, and deployed across Keepit. You will help define the standards, tooling, and practices that engineering teams across the company use to build and deliver software.

Experience designing CI/CD solutions for multiple teams and working effectively with the engineers who use them is essential for this role.

**You will:

**

• Build reusable GitLab CI/CD components and pipelines used across engineering teams.

• Build and operate highly available platform services and engineering infrastructure, including AWX, HashiCorp Vault, Terraform-based infrastructure, and other services depended on by engineering teams. Our infrastructure spans Proxmox and Kubernetes.

• Create clear, durable documentation that helps engineers understand how our platform works, why decisions were made, and how to use it effectively.

• Operate the runner infrastructure used to build, test, and deploy our software, keeping it reliable, efficient, and secure.

• Build automated tests and validation that allow us to upgrade and change the platform with confidence.

**About You

****Must-haves:

**

• Strong Linux fundamentals, particularly with Debian-based systems and APT.

• Deep understanding of CI/CD concepts and experience designing and maintaining pipelines; GitLab CI/CD experience is preferred.

• Hands-on experience with several of the technologies we use, including containers, Bash, Ansible, Kubernetes, and observability stacks such as LGTM.

• Experience designing tooling, pipelines, or infrastructure used by multiple engineering teams.

• Experience operating and evolving production systems, with the engineering judgment that comes from learning what works and what doesn't.

• Excellent communication skills in English.

• You work carefully and conscientiously, particularly when making changes to systems that other engineers depend on.

**Nice-to-haves:

**

• Understanding of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, DNS, VLANs, routing, DHCP, and firewalling.

You will be the business voice that connects commercial needs with technical delivery - translating needs into process design, requirements, governance, and adoption. You will work closely with global and local stakeholders – bringing deep respect for the knowledge of people living the day-to-day reality – while driving towards global standards that create value for LEO, our customers, and ultimately patients. When decisions are needed for the greater good of LEO and the patients we serve – you drive them through. Global IT and external partners build to your specifications.

Your key responsibilities will include:

• Designing and governing scalable customer engagement processes across global and local markets.

• Facilitating cross-functional workshops and driving alignment across Business Units, Commercial Excellence, Medical Affairs, Digital Engagement, and regional teams – and representing your portfolio credibly to senior stakeholders.

• Translating business needs into process flows, user stories, requirements, and acceptance criteria with Global IT and external partners.

• Making process design decisions within your portfolio – proceeding when alignment is reached, escalating when it’s not.

• Setting global standards, enabling train-the-trainer models, and ensuring platforms and processes are adopted successfully.

• Owning and prioritising the improvement pipeline, including business cases, benefits, adoption metrics, and continuous optimisation.

You may work across areas such as segmentation, targeting, territory planning, field execution, omnichannel journey enablement (process design, platform configuration and data flow – engagement model and channel strategy are owned by Digital Engagement), Key Account Management, event management, field coaching, analytics, and AI-enabled customer engagement insights.

When you apply, indicate which areas are your primary strength and where you have secondary experience.

Your qualifications

We imagine that you bring solid business process ownership experience from pharmaceutical or life sciences commercial operations. You understand how global platforms support local execution, and you know how to turn ambiguity into clear, practical decisions that move the business forward.

We are especially looking for:

• Extensive experience in business process design and optimisation within pharma or life sciences commercial operations.

• Experience with CRM platforms such as Veeva CRM, Salesforce Life Sciences Cloud, or equivalent.

• Proven ability to apply Lean, value stream mapping , Gemba, or similar improvement methods.

• Experience translating business needs into requirements, acceptance criteria, and delivery input for IT or external partners.

• Solid facilitation experience in global, multi-market, and cross-functional environments.

• Strong communication and presentation skills – able to articulate process rationale and build confidence with senior stakeholders.

Experience with CRM transformations, Agile delivery, business case development, pharma compliance processes, data governance, change management, or train-the-trainer models will be an advantage.

As a person, you are collaborative and curious – you genuinely want to understand how people work and what markets need. But you are not consensus-dependent: when the time comes, you decide. You have backbone, think in systems, and create clarity for others rather than accumulating decisions. You communicate in ways that enable others to self-serve, and you default to progress over perfection. You bring a structured approach to solving problems - untangling complexity rather than adding to it.

What success looks like

• Business teams experience you as a trusted partner — someone who makes their work easier through well-designed processes.

• Your processes are adopted and continuously improving — delivering measurable value, not gathering dust.

• Global standards are self-sustaining — through train-the-trainer and local enablement rather than central enforcement.

• You make decisions confidently within your portfolio — creating clarity rather than accumulating decisions.

• The customer experience improves because the processes you govern make it easier for LEO to engage healthcare professionals consistently and at scale.

Your new team

You will join Global Customer Engagement Platforms & Excellence in Ballerup, Denmark. We are a global team working at the intersection of business process, customer engagement, commercial excellence, and platform governance. Together, we partner with markets, functions, Global IT, and external implementation partners to create processes that are adopted, valuable, and built to scale.

A note from the hiring manager

I'm building a team that partners with the business and owns the outcome — not one that waits to be told what to do. A global Customer Engagement Platform implementation is kicking off imminently — and this role will be central to shaping it from the start.

I believe in partnership as the work, real ownership within clear guardrails, and progress over perfection. You are not a requirements scribe passing notes to IT — you shape how processes should work, and IT builds to that specification. If you can walk me through how you've used structured methods to align people and improve something real, I'd like to hear from you.

The opportunity comes with visibility to executive level.

Contact and application

For additional information, please contact Lisa Munkvold, Head of Global Customer Engagement Platforms, LIMUN@LEO-Pharma.com

You do not need to upload a cover letter, but feel free to add a few sentences in your resume or CV on why this position has your interest and which of the process areas above are your primary strength.

Beyond the skin

Join LEO Pharma, a global leader in medical dermatology, as we go beyond the skin to make a lasting impact. Our innovative approach sets us apart. We are dedicated to leaving a legacy that positively impacts patients, colleagues, and our planet.

At LEO Pharma, we believe in the power of individuals to drive change. Our flat organizational structure empowers you to make a visible impact and offers versatile roles for professional growth. We value diversity and welcome applications from all qualified candidates, recognizing that our different perspectives, backgrounds, and attitudes enable us to make the best decisions. Join our passionate team at LEO Pharma and be yourself as we work together to make a difference.

For certain positions, LEO Pharma might complete a background check conducted by a third party.

**In this Head of Employee Experience role, you'll be…

**

• Setting the vision and one roadmap for our Employee Experience across the employee journey, so colleagues experience one Formalize in every office and every new country.

• Building a scalable, intuitive model where people, systems, processes, IT and offices simply work, so day-to-day operations run smoothly on their own, freeing up your team to give personal, high-touch support when it matters most

• Setting up one front door for every question on people, workplace and IT, with one ticketing system and a shared knowledge base, solving most questions through self-serve and the rest first time.

• Leading a team of around ten across People Operations, Workplace and Internal IT with clear ownership, and making your team's time here a real springboard for their HR careers.

• Owning workplace standards, vendors and budgets, and opening new offices on time and on budget from one playbook.

• Working with our People Business Partners and Talent Acquisition on journeys that cross teams, such as onboarding and country launches.

****Who is the Employee Experience team?

****Employee Experience is the team that treats our colleagues like our best customers. We bring People Operations, Workplace, and Internal IT together under one roof because a great workday relies on all three: a contract and conversations that make sense, an office where we celebrate wins together, and a laptop that works from hour one.

Within People Operations, a back office sets standards, systems and automation, while People Operations Partners in the front office are the daily face for colleagues. Our People Business Partners, focused on managers and leaders, work closely with us.

Our principle is high touch where it matters, effortless everywhere else, with one front door for every question and the ambition that colleagues hardly need us.

**What you bring

**

• Proven leadership experience across the broader employee experience spectrum, combining People Operations with workplace and internal IT, ideally in a scaling international tech company.

• A builder's instinct. Your energy comes from systems, standards and support models that work every day. Events and celebrations matter but aren't the core, so if confetti is what drives you, this probably isn't your role.

• You think in models, linking the structural basis to the human interaction it enables, and you know where high personal-touch adds value and where good design does the job better.

• Strong on digital: people systems, automation and AI are how the team scales, and you're comfortable owning tooling decisions and the budget behind them.

• A strong sense of fairness and consistency, with standards explicit enough to guide people rather than slow them down.

• A hands-on leader who builds teams across disciplines and grows people into bigger roles.

• Clear communication in English, the credibility to partner effectively with our leadership team, and the ability to work from our Copenhagen office (or Aarhus).

**What do we offer you?

**

• A monthly salary ranging from 65,000 to 70,000 DKK.

• Continuous development through a clear and transparent career framework, so you always know what the next step looks like, with biannual growth talks and regular check-ins.

• Thorough pre- and onboarding to set you up for success.

• A culture of ownership, trust and independence, with the support you need.

• An office-first culture in a central location in Copenhagen or Aarhus, with benefits including pension, lunch, health insurance and social events.

• A strong team spirit where we celebrate wins and enjoy time together across offices.

• Our annual Global Summit, where the whole company meets and connects.

**Our recruitment process

**

• Send your application and upload relevant information

• 15–30-minute online interview with our Talent Acquisition team

• 30-minute interview with our Hiring Manager

• 30-minute interview with our interim Head of Talent Acquisition

• Completion of Personality Assessment

• In-person team workshop in Aarhus with representatives of People Operations, Workplace and Internal IT, where you work on a real case such as our future onboarding

About Formalize

Formalize is a tech company founded in 2021 with offices in Aarhus, Copenhagen, Milan, Munich and Madrid. Currently, we are a team of +200 people from +30 nationalities operating in multiple European markets and are one of the fastest growing SaaS scale-ups. We thrive on ambition, deliver impact through pragmatism, and embrace passion and honesty. We are celebrating our wins, learning from our mistakes, and growing together as a team.

Our journey began within the whistleblowing compliance sector, highlighted by the award-winning Whistleblower Software by Formalize, laying the foundation of our success story. Now, we have extended our expertise to a larger compliance universe, including data compliance, risk, and privacy. Our Formalize product helps companies to effortlessly navigate and stay ahead in the ever-changing landscape of compliance. Our platform adapts to regulatory changes, continuously adapting to meet and foresee the evolving needs of our users, ensuring businesses remain compliant and confident in their operations.

Still curious? Read more about us here: About Formalize.

**Ready to apply?

**We will hold interviews and hire on an ongoing basis. For more information or questions, please contact the responsible recruiter in the Talent Acquisition team. Apply now with your resume and other relevant information through our Career Page. We look forward to seeing your application!

_**Help colleagues adopt AI and grow into building it!

**_Are you studying a relevant subject and passionate about helping people get real value from AI? Are you comfortable creating content, updating a website and engaging colleagues, while also curious about the technology behind it, such as Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio and Power Platform? And would you like a role that grows from AI adoption into hands-on technical work?

At Svitzer, we are strengthening our internal AI capability and are looking for a Student Assistant to join our AI Adoption & Delivery team. You will start at the heart of our AI Adoption Program, keeping our internal GenAI site up to date and helping colleagues across the business get real value from AI. As our adoption work matures, you will gradually take on more technical assignments alongside our AI engineers and developers.

The role is based at our headquarters in Nordhavn, Copenhagen. Work hours are flexible, especially around examination periods, and we expect approximately 15-20 hours per week.

**About Us

**Svitzer is a leading global towage operator with 4,500 colleagues and a fleet of 510 vessels operating across more than 35 countries. Every day, we help keep ports open, terminals operating and global trade moving through safe, reliable and increasingly sustainable marine services.

See our tugboats in action: Svitzer Introduces TRAnsverse Tug.

**We offer

**You will join a small internal AI Team working across AI engineering, platform engineering, development and adoption. You will get real assignments with support from experienced colleagues and exposure to both the technical and practical questions involved in bringing AI into a global business.

Your assignments will evolve with you. In the beginning, most of your time will go to our AI Adoption Program and GenAI site. Over time, the balance shifts towards technical use cases. We want this to be a role where you learn, but also one where your work contributes directly to what the team delivers.

**More About The Role

**Reporting to Merethe Kiemer, Head of AI Adoption & Delivery, you will work closely with the engineers, developers and adoption colleagues in the team. Our use cases span global operations, business functions and frontline teams, from port and vessel operations to commercial and support functions. You will be an active part of our AI Adoption Program, from updating our GenAI site and creating content to supporting training and engagement activities, and you will increasingly contribute to technical work such as building solutions with Copilot Studio or Power Platform and testing AI applications.

_**Key responsibilities

**_Your role will combine AI adoption with hands-on experimentation and development. The balance between these areas will evolve over time, depending on our priorities as a team, the maturity of our adoption work, and your skills and interests.

**You Will Contribute Across Areas Such As

**AI adoption and our GenAI site

• Keep Svitzer’s internal GenAI site up to date with guidance, use cases, news, training material and FAQs.

• Support our AI Adoption Program through campaigns, training sessions, onboarding of new users and community activities.

• Help analyse usage data and user feedback and turn insights into improvements and stories that inspire colleagues.

Building and experimenting with AI

• Build simple copilots, agents and automations in Microsoft Copilot Studio and Power Platform.

• Test AI solutions and support evaluation of quality, grounding, responsible use and user feedback.

• Research new AI capabilities and help assess what could be relevant for Svitzer.

Growing into more technical use cases

• As your experience grows, contribute to more technical use cases, proofs of concept and small applications together with the engineers in the team.

• Experiment with prompts, workflows, APIs and integrations, and contribute to reusable components and documentation.

You should not expect these to be fixed stages. You may work across all three areas from the start, while the emphasis of the role will develop with our needs and with what you are ready and motivated to take on.

**Who We Are Looking For

**We are looking for a curious student who enjoys both people and technology. You are comfortable communicating with colleagues, creating content and keeping a website up to date, and you have a technical interest you want to develop. Your degree matters less than your interest in AI, your ability to learn and the things you have already tried.

**More Specifically, We Are Looking For Someone Who

**

• Holds a valid visa- and work permit (is a must)

• Is currently studying computer science, software engineering, data science, AI or another relevant field.

• Is comfortable creating content and updating websites, for example in SharePoint, and enjoys engaging colleagues in new ways of working.

• Has a profound interest in AI and digital solutions and has ideally experimented with Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio, OpenAI, Power Platform, LLMs, AI agents, machine learning, automation or small applications.

• Is comfortable learning new tools and using AI-assisted development tools for coding, testing, research and problem-solving.

• Can work in a structured way, document findings clearly and ask for guidance when scope or assumptions are unclear.

• Is fluent in written and spoken English.

A study project, university assignment, website or content you have created, hackathon or personal experiment is relevant evidence of your interest and skills. We do not expect professional AI experience.

**In Addition, You

**

• Are curious and motivated to keep learning as AI technology develops.

• Take ownership of clearly defined tasks and follow through.

• Enjoy experimenting but are equally interested in whether something actually works.

• Work collaboratively and are comfortable asking questions and seeking input.

• Communicate clearly and share what you learn with others.

**How To Apply

**Please submit your application via the “Apply” button on our Careers page. Applications submitted outside the system cannot be considered.

**Deadline

**The application deadline is 30 November 2026. We review applications on an ongoing basis and may close the advertisement earlier if we receive a strong field of qualified candidates.

**Questions

**For questions, please contact Merethe Kiemer, Head of AI Adoption & Delivery, at merethe.kiemer@svitzer.com.

**Building a Diverse Workplace

**In Svitzer we value the diversity of our talent and will always strive to recruit the best person for the job – we value diversity in all its forms, including but not limited to gender, age, nationality, race, sexual orientation, disability, or religious beliefs. We are proud of our diversity and see it as a genuine source of strength for building high performing teams.

Don’t meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that members from some under-represented groups are less likely to apply for jobs if they don’t meet every single qualification. At Svitzer we are dedicated to building a diverse and inclusive workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles, and we are excited about hearing from you!

**How To Apply

**To apply for this role, please click on the 'Apply Now' button and create a Candidate Home to manage your applications.

Senior Manager for CMC API Cultivation Pilot Plant

Category:  Manufacturing

Location:

Bagsværd, Capital Region of Denmark, DK

Sr Manager

CMC Development

CMC API Pilots, Mammalian Pilot Plant

Location: Bagsværd

Your impact begins here**. Lead with purpose. Empower people.

**

Are you an authentic, resilient, and empathetic people leader who thrives on developing people, building trust, and ensuring operational excellence in a complex API production environment?

As our new Team Leader (Sr Manager) for the Mammalian Pilot Plants (MPP) Cultivation team, you will lead 15 dedicated scientists and technicians producing Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (API) for clinical studies. You will play a key role in ensuring strong operations, fostering collaboration, and managing stakeholders across our API pilot production activities, from cultivation to recovery and purification. You will be a visible and approachable leader on the shopfloor, creating an environment built on psychological safety, trust, and teamwork. You will also join a close-knit leadership team where colleagues support, challenge, and inspire each other to succeed.

Ready to lead and make a difference? Apply today!

**

What you’ll do**

As Sr Manager of the mammalian cultivation team, you will lead a team responsible for daily operations in our cultivation facility. A key part of your success will be your ability to coordinate and engage in prioritization with your manager colleagues across the department to ensure high quality, production activities and team engagement.

Furthermore, you have a preference to set and meet ambitious goals on the premise that success is achieved through collaboration and sharing key observations early to accelerate delivery. You are motivated by being on shopfloor daily, visible to your employees and engaging in problem solving.

You will primarily be responsible for the cultivation of API for phase 1, 2 and 3 studies ensuring high quality and compliance. Your team consists of 15 employees (Scientists and Technicians) who are preparing, conducting, and reporting API production campaigns in close collaboration with the development and production areas of Novo.

You will join a growing area preparing for taking in more exciting development projects and expanding capacity for the supply of our portfolio. Your main tasks will be to:

• Ensure delivery according to ambitious production plans with a high level of quality

• Coordinate and engage in prioritization with your manager colleagues across the department to ensure high-quality level, production activities and team engagement.

• Continuously ensure high level of psychological safety, motivation and engagement in your team

• Day-to-day visible on shopfloor, engaging with your employees, in problem solving and identifying opportunities to optimize our workflow and processes through a structured approach.

As Sr Manager you will be part of the leadership team in CMC MPP, which is composed of 1 Director, 4 Sr Managers and an administrative coordinator that meets frequently, help and support each other, and routinely use each other as sparring partners.

What you’ll bring

To succeed in this role, you will need a technical background, master’s degree or PhD in science/technology, biochemical/chemical engineering, pharmacy, or other relevant fields. Furthermore, you will need:

• Experience in the pharma industry and knowledge of GMP (Good Manufacturing Practices) is preferred.

• Leadership experience and a natural desire to engage, develop and empower people.

• Ability to communicate and collaborate effectively with both internal and external collaboration partners.

• The ability to challenge status quo and see LEAN as a natural part of your daily work.

• Fluency in written and spoken English.

You are a strong relationship builder who creates trust and followership within your team. You empower and involve your employees, lead with authenticity, and motivate others to deliver high-quality results. You thrive in a dynamic development environment with competing priorities and complex problem-solving. You balance leadership and operational management effectively and bring an innovative, flexible mindset.

**Who you’ll work with

**CMC Development's role in Novo's value chain is to turn molecules into approved products in close cooperation with our colleagues in R&ED, Development and Global Manufacturing and Supply.  As part of CMC Development, CMC API Pilots is the preferred partner for API production supporting clinical trials and ensuring process transfer to commercial production.

The CMC MPP department is organised within CMC API Pilots and we are 65 employees divided into four teams, three facilities, and two locations. Our primary task is to produce API for clinical studies supporting Novo’s important strategic projects within our mammalian platform.

What you can expect hereYou will work in an international environment where your expertise is valued, and your contribution can shape decisions across areas. You will be supported to perform at your best and trusted to take ownership. You will be encouraged to make your voice heard, learn from leadership colleagues and contribute to work that helps create progress for people living with serious chronic diseases. We foster a collaborative culture where we care for one another, value initiative, and empower you to drive projects forward while growing professionally.

**What we offer

**Salary: The annual base salary for this role ranges from DKK 742.600 to DKK 1.091.600, depending on the level of the position. Placement within the range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

Incentives and benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives and other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area, and relevant market benchmarks. Learn more about our Reward Philosophy here.

Start nowPlease apply before 2 December 2026. We will interview in December and aim to make a decision before the Christmas break.

If you have any questions about the job, you are welcome to contact Director, Anette Sikjær Jørgensen at ASIJ@novonordisk.com

Please include a short motivation in your CV explaining why you are the ideal candidate to join us. Please do not include a photo in your CV, as this supports a fair and efficient recruitment process.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

Your impact begins here

As our P&O Student Assistant, you will help keep People & Organisation (P&O) running smoothly. You will support a variety of activities across administration, communication and events, from welcoming new colleagues to keeping information accurate and easy to access. Along the way, we encourage you to bring your ideas and help us find smarter and simpler ways of working.

What you’ll bring

You are studying, curious and organised, and you like making things work for other people.

• Currently enrolled in a university or business school programme, preferably in your 2nd or 3rd year within human resources or a similar field.

• Fluency in Danish and English, written and spoken.

• The ability to prioritise your studies alongside part-time work and meet deadlines without compromising quality.

• Attention to detail and accuracy when handling administrative information and following established guidelines.

• A proactive, can-do attitude, with the adaptability and learning agility to pick up new tasks, processes and digital tools quickly.

• Clear written and verbal communication, and a collaborative approach to working with colleagues.

Useful, but not essential:

Familiarity with HR activities or related tasks. Prior experience is preferred but not required.

What you’ll do

You will be the extra pair of hands and fresh pair of eyes that keeps P&O operations accurate, organised and moving.

• Keep P&O information accurate and accessible by updating SharePoint sites, managing content and permissions, and maintaining distribution lists and hierarchy overviews across affiliates.

• Create posts on Viva Engage and contribute to internal P&O communication, building a strong understanding of the organisational structure as you go.

• Support HR administration, including the archive, organisational organograms, and updates to employee information and organisational changes.

• Support onboarding and exit processes together with the P&O Partnering Professional, including IT system access, training schedules and orientation materials, as well as planning, coordination and booking for exits.

• Handle practical office and fleet administration for the Danish affiliate, including BroBizz, parking and parking permits, and support compliant and efficient purchasing.

• Support the PA and Internal Communication Professional with company days, events, seminars, meetings and catering, and contribute ideas to process optimisation and digital tools that reduce complexity.

• Handle procurement and purchasing activities, including purchase orders, invoice follow-up and related administration.

• Support with general ad hoc tasks and activities across P&O.

Who you’ll work with

You will join People & Organisation within International Operations, where colleagues work across markets to serve people around the world and help improve health at scale. You will report to the People and Organisation Director. As part of a team of five, you will work closely with the P&O Partnering Professional and the PA & Internal Communication Professional in your day-to-day role.

You will also collaborate with colleagues and stakeholders from different functions and affiliates, and take part in cross-functional discussions where we encourage you to bring your own ideas and perspectives. By staying organised, proactive and focused on priorities, you will help keep things moving and make a valuable contribution to the team.

What you can expect here

You will learn from experienced professionals and get a close view of how P&O supports a global organisation. You will build practical skills in HR administration, process improvement and internal communication, and be trusted to take ownership of your tasks and make your voice heard.

This is a one-year contract with the possibility of extension. The role is approximately 15–20 hours per week, with flexibility to increase or reduce your hours depending on your studies.

Salary and Benefits

This position is hourly paid, and the hourly base rate is DKK 209,27. In addition to the hourly base rate, Student Assistants are entitled to a pension scheme (currently 10% employer contribution and 5% employee contribution).

Start now

Your impact begins today. If you are ready to bring structure, curiosity and a can-do attitude to P&O, apply for the P&O Student Intern role by 30 November 2026. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

Associate Director – SAP P&O

Location - Bagsvaerd

Your impact begins here

As Associate Director – SAP P&O, you will lead a multidisciplinary team supporting Novo's digital People & Organisation landscape. You will strengthen the core capabilities, partner closely with the business on digitalization projects and activities within the SAP P&O scope and set clear priorities so your team can deliver. As a member of the SAP P&O leadership team, you will turn strategy into team commitments and drive day-to-day leadership initiatives.

What you’ll bring

We are looking for a technically credible people leader. You bring:

• 
Demonstrated people leadership experience, with responsibility for hiring, onboarding, employee development, engagement, performance and the annual people cycle. This is not a first-time people manager role.

• 
A strong technical foundation in either SAP enterprise technologies or digital HR solutions and platforms, such as SAP SuccessFactors, Workday, Oracle HCM or Cornerstone.

• 
Credibility in joining in on discussions on solution design, integrations, architecture governance, platform lifecycles and delivery dependencies, without needing to be a hands-on solution architect. You need to be able to understand the challenges and work with the team to find the right solutions.

• 
Experience balancing project demand, operations and specialist capacity, including managing stakeholders and external delivery partners.

• 
Practical operational financial experience covering vendors, purchase orders, invoicing, forecast reviews and cost control.

• 
An inclusive and empathetic leadership style: you build trust across cultures, give constructive feedback, address performance concerns, motivate teams through change and work effectively with senior business and IT stakeholders.

Useful, but not essential:

Familiarity with complex international HR processes, SAP payroll and time solutions, enterprise architecture forums, IT delivery practices, coaching or change management, or Novo's ways of working. We welcome applications from internal and external candidates; internal experience is an advantage, not a requirement.

What you’ll do

You will lead the team, keep delivery moving and make sure the right capabilities are in place for what comes next.

• 
Lead employees across the full employee lifecycle, from attraction and onboarding to performance, reward discussions, career development, wellbeing and succession planning, partnering with the Director and HR on relevant compensation decisions.

• 
Build and run a three-year capability and resource roadmap aligned to the SAP P&O technology strategy, covering critical skills, training priorities, internal and external capacity, knowledge continuity and collaboration with Global Business Services.

• 
Create a learning culture with meaningful development plans, coaching, mentoring and communities of practice across SAP & Ecosystems, and identify critical talent, successors and retention risks.

• 
Ensure delivery and the right use of capacity: Make sure IT and architecture work across the portfolio is well planned, resourced and communicated. Technical decisions stay with team members. Plan team capacity across operations, product development and major programmes. Spot risks early and resolve conflicts with partners.

• 
Lead monthly operational financial follow-up for SAP P&O software licence cost centres and external resources managed from Denmark, and prepare a concise budget position with exceptions forecast changes and required actions.

• 
Create a trust based work environment with a focus on reducing unnecessary complexity, collaboration and supporting colleagues through an evolving technology landscape and ways of working.

Who you’ll work with

You will join the SAP P&O leadership team within Enterprise IT & Quality, where colleagues work across the Novo value chain, staying close to stakeholders and helping deliver trusted technology, high quality and responsible ways of working.

Your team brings together several digital profiles from the SAP P&O DK and US location. Your closest partners are the Director, peers in the Global Business Support in India , the Portfolio Manager, counterparts from People & Organization, with whom you will identify dependencies, negotiate allocation and resolve conflicts early. You will also work with HR, Global Business Services, senior business and IT stakeholders, and external delivery partners, and collaborate across SAP & Ecosystems.

Clear priorities and open conversations keep the work moving, so your team can execute without unnecessary escalation or micromanagement.

What you can expect here

You will be trusted and empowered to lead day to day and to shape the direction and capabilities of the area as part of the SAP P&O leadership team. You will work across specialist disciplines, vendors and stakeholders, and build your own leadership range as you guide a team through evolving technology and ways of working. We operate with a high degree of trust and independence and you enjoy an environment where we challenge each other, we test out new things and we are ok at failing and learning along the way.

Salary

For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 847,000.00 to 1,245,100.00 DKK, corresponding to the level of the position.
